name: Duos Technologies Group, Inc.
business_overview: Duos Technologies Group, Inc. designs, develops, deploys, and operates intelligent technology solutions in North America. Its solutions include applications for real-time data acquisition and analysis, including the inspection and monitoring of fast-moving vehicles, as well as the deployment of distributed computing infrastructure and related services. The company is also involved in development and deployment of edge data center infrastructure and related hosting services; design and delivery of Artificial Intelligence (AI)-enabled technologies and analytics platforms; provision of technology systems and integrated solutions for infrastructure and industrial applications; delivery of consulting and energy-related services, including power infrastructure planning and asset management services; and provision of technology solutions services, including procurement, logistics coordination, and deployment support for digital infrastructure projects. It also engages in the provision of technology systems, AI technologies, technical support, hosting, and technology services. In addition, the company provides consulting services, including consulting and auditing; software licensing with optional hardware sales; customer service training; and maintenance/support. Duos Technologies Group, Inc. is headquartered in Jacksonville, Florida.

classification_meta.logic_summary: Duos Technologies provides intelligent technology solutions, AI analytics, edge computing infrastructure, and consulting services to industrial and infrastructure clients in North America.

narrative.text:
**Business & market dynamics:** Duos is undergoing a fundamental transformation from its legacy rail focus to a pure-play AI and edge infrastructure provider. The pivot capitalizes on surging demand for modular, high-density Edge Data Centers and GPU-as-a-Service, reflecting powerful macro tailwinds in AI compute and behind-the-meter power solutions. Customer activity has accelerated, with large contract wins and growing deferred revenue in Technology Solutions. However, the business remains in an early, investment-heavy phase where rapid top-line expansion coexists with ongoing net losses, highlighting both the enormous addressable opportunity and the inherent execution risks of scaling a new platform.

**Management strategy and execution:** Leadership is aggressively reshaping the company through a strategic divestiture of the rail division, a significant capital raise, and the launch of GPUaaS and high-density EDC offerings. The team is guiding toward sharply higher revenue and expects EBITDA to turn positive in the second half of 2026 as data center margins ramp. Credibility is mixed: while recent quarters have delivered record revenues and two consecutive periods of positive adjusted EBITDA, the company slightly missed its prior-year target and quarterly earnings expectations. The narrative balances ambitious repositioning against the need for consistent execution to achieve its profitability inflection.
